task_description.overview: Apply a sequence of preprocessing operations to DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensing) time-series data to prepare it for further analysis.
steps: Load the raw DAS data from the input file.
Perform detrending to remove linear trends from the data.
Apply demeaning to subtract the mean value from each channel.
Normalize the data amplitude if required.
Optionally apply phase2strain conversion to change data type.
Optionally perform stacking, cosine taper, and padding as needed.
If converting data type, use time integration or time differential to update attributes.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using Daspy package to load and process the DAS data from {das_data_path}. Apply the following preprocessing operations seperately (! not sequence): detrending, demeaning, normalization(method='z-score), stacking(N=10), cosine_taper, downsampling(xint=10,tint=2), and time_integration. Plot a 2x4 subplots figure to show the data at each step (raw, detrending, demeaning, normalization, stacking, cosine_taper, downsampling, time_integration). Note: consider use the Daspy to do the loading, processing and figureing. 2) Save the figure to {result_figure}.
